goal: CI and session speed: less CPU per Pages build
notes: Metric: CPU and wall time of one warm `node platform/pages/build.mjs --out=<dir>` (PAGES_CARD_CACHE warm, 4-core container, Node 22.23.4). Before (old code, interleaved): user 34.6/35.0/33.5 s, wall 37.3/41.4/42.3 s. After: user 32.5/33.1/33.1 s, wall 37.1/39.1/41.8 s. The four icons, fresh process each: 1,146-1,284 ms drawn, 3 ms from the cache. Share pass on the build's 10,257 captured inputs: 17,444 to 10,259 full-page META scans (457 to 270 MB scanned), wall 2.23-2.94 s to 2.16-2.73 s, output cmp-identical. Full build: diff -rq old vs new over 30,142 files differs only in version.json built_at. Full platform/pages suite with the change (node --test "*.test.mjs" "cloudflare/*.test.mjs", warm PAGES_CARD_CACHE): 1,714 tests, 1,688 pass, 0 fail, 26 skipped, 337 s wall (the session's own benchmarks shared the 4 cores; no before figure for the suite was taken this run).
